report: I saw selection change between each WATCH READ and READ DONE. I didn't notice any selection changes at other times.
decisionReport: The temporary selection change is fine. Modal usage is expected - use the agent to interact with Bitwig, and for the most part don't touch Bitwig while the agent is controlling it.
acceptedRule: Modal use permits temporary selection changes. Restore slot track, slot row, and mixer track at close under the E99 lease; unsubscribe for release. A lost lease refuses restoration.
